notes: A castle players wander to reach three different minigames is the Minigame preset, but I replaced its space-staged shape with the genre's own space-bounded, because the author put the games in rooms and areas inside and around one literal castle - the genre note warns that an isolated stage is conditional and forcing one costs P4 for nothing, so teleporter-link went with it. I did not name Obby, Action or Racing as secondaries: a varied set of rounds is what this genre is, so naming the content of each area would be three secondary genres read out of one castle, and the P6 those two carry genre-wide does not follow a genre that is not leading. Decided without a user: the great hall is social-hub and it is where the roulette table, arcade cabinets, slot machines and card tables go as non-interactive props, so they add no route of their own; trigger-scoring gives each of the three games somewhere to register a completion, and spectator-zone serves the sword arena.
